drift.policy: first 200 fixed reference; latest 100 non-overlapping observations; PSI warning at 0.20; monitoring only
drift.interpretation: Changes can reflect venue or race mix; do not automatically retrain or change bets.

realtime.interpretation: Only observed pre-close changes are stored. Final paired scoring uses the last valid snapshot; cancelled races are excluded.

baseline.event: highest-score trifecta combination hits; one observation per race

candidate.event: highest-score trifecta combination hits; one observation per race

paired_intervals.method: 1000 paired bootstrap samples of whole date blocks; 95% percentile interval
paired_intervals.direction: candidate minus baseline; negative log loss/Brier is better, positive hit rate/ROI is better
paired_intervals.limitation: Exploratory monitoring only; intervals do not adjust for repeated inspection or candidate selection.

diagnostics.promotion: No automatic production promotion. Future chronological holdout evaluation is still required.

interpretation: Prospective paired shadow evaluation. No historical reconstruction or production promotion.

health.limitation: A report is refreshed only when the workflow runs; this alone cannot detect a completely stopped scheduler. No external notifications are sent.
